title: Giving stuff away

persona.name: Sam
persona.style: calm, a little too upbeat, says 'all good' a lot, deflects with jokes, opens up when asked directly

situation: Sam says everything is fine, but this week they gave away their favorite hoodie and their gaming setup, and posted 'thanks for everything guys'.
opening: did u like the hoodie lol

facts.text: says they just didn't need the stuff
things at home have been really tense
has felt numb for a few weeks
feels like everyone would be better off without them
has been having thoughts of suicide
gave things away because they didn't think they'd need them
would go to the counselor today if you went too
agrees to call or text 988 with you

1: home has been kinda a lot
2: honestly everyone would be better off
i dont really see it changing
3: thats why i gave stuff away i guess
i didnt think anyone would notice
